chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) at the beginning of his Caliphate.
Fulfill the obligations of God, and attend to the affairs of the creatures, and fear God regarding the lands and the beasts, for you will be questioned about them and other things.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about accountability for lands and animals in his first sermon?
ai.summary: Delivered at the dawn of his caliphate, this passage from Nahj al-Balagha establishes the theological foundation of Imam Ali’s governance by linking political authority to comprehensive accountability (hisab) over all domains of creation. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the ruler’s duty to manage natural resources and livestock with justice, illustrating that stewardship extends beyond human subjects to include the environment and beasts.

en.sayed-ali-raza: At the beginning of his Caliphate.
